tokenForm.lede: Tools for your agents to read and work on pull requests, Actions runs and issues, on Forgejo or Gitea.

family.name: forgejo
family.description: Forgejo and Gitea pull requests, issues and Actions runs.

tools.name: forgejo_pulls
tools.description: Pull requests, most recently updated first, with state, branches, reviewers and whether each can merge. owner, name and host come from the git remote.

host.description: The server in the git remote, e.g. codeberg.org.

tools.name: forgejo_pull_files
tools.description: The files a pull request changes, with status and line counts. Name paths for their diffs; a long diff comes in parts, with a note on the rest.

host.description: The server in the git remote, e.g. codeberg.org.

paths.description: Only these files, each with its patch.

offset.description: Patch line to start from, from 0. The note gives the next one.

lines.description: Patch lines to return. Default 400, at most 1000; a patch also stops at 32 KB.

tools.name: forgejo_comments
tools.description: What people wrote on a pull request or an issue, oldest first. Pull requests and issues share one count.

host.description: The server in the git remote, e.g. codeberg.org.

number.description: The pull request's or issue's number.

tools.name: forgejo_issues
tools.description: A repository's issues on Forgejo or Gitea, 30 to a page, with labels and assignees.

host.description: The server in the git remote, e.g. codeberg.org.

labels.description: Only issues with these labels, comma separated.

tools.name: forgejo_runs
tools.description: Recent Actions runs, newest first, with status, conclusion, branch and the pull request each ran for. A server too old for Actions in its API says so.

host.description: The server in the git remote, e.g. codeberg.org.

tools.name: forgejo_run
tools.description: One Actions run with its jobs and their steps' status, to see which job failed.

host.description: The server in the git remote, e.g. codeberg.org.

runId.description: The run's id from forgejo runs.

tools.name: forgejo_job_log
tools.description: One Actions job's log without colour codes: its end, grep matches or a line range, at most 30,000 characters. Start with the tail or a grep for the error.

host.description: The server in the git remote, e.g. codeberg.org.

jobId.description: A job's id from forgejo run.

tail.description: Lines kept, from the end or from from. Default 200, at most 2000.

grep.description: Only lines containing this, ignoring case.
